items.note: Compares human-generated alternate-uses ideas with ideas from six generative AI chatbots, scored by humans and a trained AI; no participant uses AI.

Compares short stories from 60 LLMs and 60 people on novelty, surprise, diversity, and rated creativity; no human-with-AI condition (Holzner et al. CD03 coding as people with vs without AI looks like an error).

Participants are assigned to human-human pairs (68) or human-GPT-4o pairs (72) for the Alternative Uses Task and creative writing, with originality and diversity outcomes (about 208 people implied; abstract from the OSF preprint record says 'assigned' without stating random).

Students write short stories with and without ChatGPT in a study the abstract calls naturalistic; AI stories are more original but more semantically similar; assignment (random, within-person, or self-selected) must be checked in the full text.
Compares human outputs with GPT-4 outputs under naive and expert prompting on text, drawing, and alternate-uses tasks, scored by external raters and NLP measures; no participant uses AI.
225 university students do a creative writing task with ChatGPT or as a control group without it, with creativity of output scored plus pre/post surveys; assignment method not stated in the abstract.

Compares product ideas from students collected before LLMs with GPT-4 zero-shot and few-shot ideas on purchase intent, novelty, and pairwise similarity; abstract read from the Wharton working-paper PDF; no participant uses AI.
Collects 600 short stories from human participants and GPT-3 (plus 120 GPT-4 stories) and compares rated creativity; no participant uses AI.

Three studies relate question-asking complexity to open- and closed-ended problem solving in humans and compare with AI responses; no participant uses AI (abstract seen only as a repository summary after ScienceDirect blocked access).

Quasi-experiment with 80 postgraduate students who develop an innovative research proposal while interacting with a GAI chatbot or with peers; practical performance on the proposal is the scored outcome (an ai_vs_active comparison; check whether the performance score is rated or self-reported).
